subject: Use __mulh(), __umulh() intrinsics for MSVC x64
perf_evidence: Commit selects native MSVC x64 high-multiply intrinsics in the division helpers.
change_summary: Adds MSVC x64 high-multiply intrinsics, but the committed header has an unterminated preprocessor conditional.

units.name: committed MSVC x64 signed and unsigned high-multiply paths
units.evidence: Clang targeting x86_64-pc-windows-msvc rejects the actual new header: unterminated conditional at libdivide.h:322. No valid new LLVM IR exists for Alive2.

units.name: repaired-header MSVC model, high multiplies and generated division
units.precondition: One-character #if-to-#elif repair in candidate header; d != 0 for generated division
units.evidence: With that explicit repair, four high-multiply/API targets pass bidirectional Alive2 with unroll 4. This is conditional evidence, not proof of the committed source.

notes: new_fixed/libdivide.h differs from new/libdivide.h by exactly changing the erroneous #if HAS_INT128_T to #elif HAS_INT128_T. The repaired run must not be promoted to a verdict about the original commit.
